title: Search Explain API Contract
text: The search explain endpoint returns matched terms, lexical score, vector score, fusion score, selected mode, and per-result reasons. Clients use the endpoint to debug why a cell was returned for a query.

title: Storage Validation Runbook
text: Storage validation checks the manifest, segment files, bitmap indexes, lexical indexes, vector indexes, HNSW graph files, candidate ids, and WAL scan. Repair should start with dry-run mode before applying cleanup.

title: SDK Release Gate
text: The SDK release gate requires package dry-runs, live local server contract tests, registry publication guardrails, examples artifact packaging, and deprecation policy checks before publication.

title: Server Security Configuration
text: Server security configuration includes bearer tokens, policy-store principals, request body limits, per-token quotas, CORS allowlist, tenant validation, and audit log redaction.

title: Query Routing Strategy
text: Query routing chooses lexical, vector, or hybrid retrieval based on query shape. Explain output should include the selected strategy and the fallback reason when ANN is not production safe.
